value.summary: The change updates a test fixture from constructing an EpisodeState via `opened(conversation, Sequence(1))` to directly populating `watermark` and `round_start` fields, reflecting a type refactor. The values chosen — `watermark: Sequence(1)` matching the old watermark argument and `round_start: Sequence(u64::MAX)` to make a width-one round identical to a sequential episode — are consistent with how the rest of the codebase uses these fields. No bugs introduced; safe to merge.
